method.physicalLines: splitlines; includes blank lines and comments; a final newline creates no additional line
method.nonBlankLines: non-whitespace lines; comments retained, not logical SLOC
method.addedDeleted: SequenceMatcher(auto-junk false), baseline versus current once per path; not cumulative batch edits
method.contracts: src/contracts/** or files named contracts.ts/ports.ts or ending -contracts.ts/-ports.ts/-types.ts; mixed validation code inside those files stays in this file bucket
method.baselineNewRule: src/tests code absent from complete B1 source manifest treated as added paths; migration/copies are not claimed newly authored
method.docs: current docs/**/*.md excluding history/archive/evidence; no reliable B1 full documentation baseline so no doc added/deleted claims
method.importsDedup: explicit imported files/changes maps only; frozenFiles and diagnostics excluded; each current path counted once
method.unimported: two lane exact allowed files versus originalAllowedHashes; excluded from current totals
method.generated: dist and Kernel frozen/generated dist measured separately; source-map sourcesContent used only to establish patch baseline

importEvidenceCoverage.note: Batch rows are source/import provenance only. No summing multiple imports for one path, and no allocating shared-file lines to one batch without intermediate source baseline.

ratios.note: Source includes contracts/Host/UI and excludes scripts/Kernel/docs/generated; file-based line counts include comments. Ratios are descriptive, not a test-quality or overdesign verdict.

reviewCandidates.reason: Large new domain services combine request identity/replay, principal/scope admission, state reads and atomic commits; review common mechanics against existing Store/owner seams, while preserving different domain lifecycles. Size alone does not prove duplication.
Future-plan and initial-plan consumers grew in existing files; check repeated normalization/validation across reader, writer and codec boundaries only against reachable public paths.
Host/UI growth is real new consumer wiring; inspect repeated response/render wrappers and raw input forms when following confirmed product UI, not by deleting behavior to reduce line count.
